sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module equips students with the theoretical foundations and practical skills of financial data analysis. Students will gain expertise in applying econometric models to solve real-world problems in the financial realm. The curriculum emphasizes the implementation of relevant time series methods and the critical evaluation of empirical findings.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Grasping the theoretical foundations of financial econometrics B. Applying appropriate econometric methodologies to analyze financial data C. Utilizing econometric techniques to tackle real-world problems in the financial realm D. Developing proficiency in utilizing econometric software for empirical analysis
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module will be delivered through lectures, which will equip students with a solid theoretical foundation in financial econometrics, and tutorials, in which students will gain practical experience in conducting empirical analyses.
